derivation: (Aramaic) properly, corresponding to H748 (אָרַךְ), but used only in the sense of reaching to a given point;

occurrences.text: Now because we have maintenance from the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
